evidence.claim: FAR 官方职位正文的团队段自述：团队通过前沿基础模型与端到端学习系统构建智能机器人；工作覆盖多模态感知与可应对多样真实场景的操作策略；并使用亚马逊算力与真实数据训练和部署基础模型，目标覆盖亚马逊全球运营规模
evidence.quote: At Frontier AI & Robotics, we're not just advancing robotics – we're reimagining it from the ground up. Our team is building the future of intelligent robotics through frontier foundation models and end-to-end learned systems. ... We leverage Amazon's computational infrastructure and rich real-world datasets to train and deploy state-of-the-art foundation models. ... We're building systems that don't just work in the lab, but scale to meet the demands of Amazon's global operations.
evidence.source_title: Technical Lab Manager - Robotics R&D, Frontier AI & Robotics（Job ID 10426076）
evidence.note: 目标表述（scale to global operations）是方向性自述，不等于已实现部署；不写成 FAR 已服务亚马逊运营。

evidence.claim: FAR 官方岗位职责要求承担高自由度机器人硬件原型装配、集成与验证，包括执行器、传感器、机器加工件装配、硬件版本验证与台架/HIL 测试
evidence.quote: You'll lead a strong robotics technician and lab engineering team to support high degrees of freedom (DoF) robotic hardware prototype assembly and validation. ... Assemble & integrate robotic hardware (actuators, sensors, vision, machined components).
evidence.quote_locator: 职位详情「A day in the life」与「Key job responsibilities」
evidence.source_title: Technical Lab Manager - Robotics R&D, Frontier AI & Robotics (Job ID 10426076)
evidence.note: 本行摘录经逐字复核位于 Job 10426076 页面（Key job responsibilities 与 A day in the life 两段）；原送审版本把本行绑到 10424277，属页面错绑，已按原文更正。原 10424277 页面快照仍保留在 evidence_snapshots 内，该页只用于确认同一 FAR 团队第二个岗位的存在。

evidence.claim: FAR 的公开代码组织自述为「Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics Org」，公开仓库包含仿真／运动控制（holosoma）、人形数据采集（TWIST2）、行为克隆训练评估（ABC）、机器人控制策略（fpo-control）、生成式世界模型（deltatok）等方向
